principles: Use the assigned bow for mounted harassment, disruption, and precision fire while preserving maneuver space.
Charge only when terrain, cohesion, target disorder, and tactical advantage justify closing.
On charge: bow away, cavalry lance and shield ready, keep ordered spacing and mutual support.
When mounted spear reach is lost, the spear breaks, becomes trapped, or close terrain makes it unsuitable: transition immediately to sword and shield.
Core progression: BOW -> CAVALRY LANCE + SHIELD -> ONE-HANDED LONG SWORD + SHIELD.
Kill at distance. Charge only on advantage. Break them with the lance. Draw the sword once distance is gone.
